headword: {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}

definitions.gloss: cutting-edge technology; advanced technology; high technology
definitions.explanation: The most advanced or innovative technology available in a given field. Refers to technology at the forefront of development.

examples.japanese: {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日|ひ}々⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cutting-edge technology in this field is advancing day by day.

examples.japanese: {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}して→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: We are working on solving social problems by utilizing advanced technology.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧ (tip, forefront) + ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (technology, technique). Widely used in news, business, and academic contexts to describe the latest technological innovations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop advanced technology
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧: to utilize cutting-edge technology
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧: the field of advanced technology
- {先端技術|せんたんぎじゅつ}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: high-tech company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最先端|さいせんたん}{技術|ぎじゅつ}→最先端技術：18152_saisentangijutsu⟧: the very latest technology — slightly stronger emphasis on being the absolute forefront
- ハイテク: high-tech — a casual loanword abbreviation
- ⟦{科学技術|かがくぎじゅつ}→科学技術：20794_kagakugijutsu⟧: science and technology — broader term encompassing both science and technology
- {情報技術|じょうほうぎじゅつ}: information technology (IT) — specifically about computing and data
